text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm! Their boundless potential was on full 
display!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...And, have you decided? On the Japan 
representative."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I don't have any hesitation left.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Let's go announce the members representing 
Japan, Yayoi.
